name: Retro
oneLiner: Vintage palettes and nostalgic type sitting on modern structure: nostalgic without being costume.

notes: Burnt orange on cream clears 4.5:1 for headings but not for 12px text — use ink for anything small.
The cream ground lightens the whole page; keep muted copy at the textMuted role, never at an opacity.

sources.label: Palette and positioning authored for dsh-uiux; name from awesome-design-skills

primary.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface)

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-text); border-radius: var(--uiux-radius-full); background: transparent; color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase
height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--uiux-color-surface); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem
default.focusVisible: border-color: var(--uiux-color-accent); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(194, 65, 12, 0.22)

do: Keep to the 70s print palette: cream paper, burnt orange, mustard, ink.
Set the display face in Fraunces, tracked tight, at poster scale.
Separate with thick rules and colour blocks instead of shadows.
dont: Do not use pure white or pure black as background.
Do not round controls into pills unless they are tags.
Do not add photographic images with modern drop shadows.
antiPatterns: A gradient sunset behind a modern sans headline.
Blurred glass panels over print colours.
